metaData.title: Meitu Released 8 Products at Once, and After Trying Them All, I Found They Are Doing the Same Thing
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Meitu released eight AI products at its Imaging Festival, shifting its core logic from "making users learn tools" to "letting users directly get results," achieving "delivery-style AI" across scenarios like photo retouching, talking videos, MVs, and e-commerce materials through AI Agent teams.
metaData.summary: Based on the author's hands-on experience with the eight products released at the Meitu Imaging Festival, the article analyzes Meitu's latest strategic shift in the AI imaging field. It highlights Picchi (which learns personal retouching styles from user-uploaded before-and-after photos or borrows aesthetics from influencers), MVLAND (which deeply understands musical structures to automatically generate matching MVs), Kaipai (which fully auto-edits talking videos into finished clips), Meitu Design Studio (which generates a full set of e-commerce materials from a single product image), and RoboNeo (a tool for scaled short drama production). The article points out that unlike industry-standard AI tools that emphasize "generation capabilities," Meitu this time focuses on "delivering results." By building an "AI imaging team" composed of specialized Agents, it allows users to get finished products directly without learning complex tool operations. The author believes this approach of "making AI adapt to people and being responsible for the results" elevates the baseline of AI products from "generation" to "delivery."

mainPoints.point: Meitu's eight AI products collectively shift towards "delivery-style AI," allowing users to directly obtain results without learning the tools.
mainPoints.explanation: From Picchi's retouching style learning to Kaipai's auto-editing of talking videos, Meitu uses multi-Agent teams to replace user operations, outputting ready-to-use finished products and lowering the barrier to entry.

mainPoints.point: Picchi achieves personalized style memory and borrowing through "Learn My Retouching" and "Learn Their Retouching".
mainPoints.explanation: Users can upload 3-10 sets of before-and-after photos to create an exclusive retouching model, or directly use presets from professional makeup artists to batch output retouching results with a consistent style.

mainPoints.point: MVLAND deeply understands musical structures to automatically generate mood-matching MVs.
mainPoints.explanation: By analyzing beats, sections, and emotions, MVLAND produces an MV in 10 minutes that would originally cost tens of thousands of yuan, solving the pain point of MV scarcity in the short-video era.

mainPoints.point: Meitu's "AI Imaging Team" elevates the industry standard from "generation" to "delivery".
mainPoints.explanation: The author believes that Meitu is no longer just competing on generation speed, but taking responsibility for the usability of the final results, covering scenarios like retouching, talking videos, e-commerce, and short dramas.

keyQuotes: From 'users learning tools' to 'users directly getting results'
Whether an AI product succeeds or not ultimately comes down to this: it's not about how much it generated, but whether you actually used it, whether you actually got that result.
Elevating the baseline of AI products from 'generation' to 'delivery'.

relatedArticles.title: iPhone Finally Gets Siri AI! But Mainland China Misses Out on the First Release, Alarm Clock Becomes the Biggest Surprise
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: WWDC26 unveils iOS 27 and new Apple Intelligence developments, upgrading Siri to a system-level AI assistant with its own app, but users in mainland China will temporarily miss out on the AI features.

relatedArticles.title: AI R&D Automation: Wiki Knowledge Base + Skill Pack
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how to build a continuously growing team knowledge base and a supporting expert skill pack based on the LLM-Wiki model and the Obsidian platform to achieve AI-driven R&D automation.

relatedArticles.title: Dialogue with MiniMax's Zeyin: Agents Will Eventually Surpass Humans, Where Do We Go From Here?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Through an in-depth conversation with Zeyin, a MiniMax Agent R&D engineer, this article reveals the design philosophy and technical details of the Agent Team architecture, as well as the industry consensus and trend shifting from model competition to scaffolding competition in Agent engineering.

relatedArticles.title: Just Released: GPT-5.6 — Most Powerful Ever, Yet Self-Sabotaged
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article reports on the GPT-5.6 series launch, including details on three models (Sol/Terra/Luna), benchmark results, tiered safety measures, and US government review of access permissions, analyzing how frontier model releases are entering a new cycle shaped by national security concerns.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Harness Engineering: Finding the Shell That Keeps AI from Going Rogue—Insights from 14 Engineering Articles | Hao's Trend Talk
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of "Harness Engineering," a core technology in the AI Agent field. It reveals how to compensate for model shortcomings through a three-layer management architecture and proposes the logic of "Compensation Surface Migration" that evolves with model capabilities.

relatedArticles.title: Understanding Hermes in One Article: How the New Top-Tier Agent Self-Evolves from Experience
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the core innovation of the Hermes Agent—the Skills closed-loop system—detailing its complete implementation mechanism, from experience extraction and knowledge storage to intelligent retrieval and self-improvement, along with its engineering trade-offs and security considerations.

relatedArticles.title: WeChat AI: The Most Detailed Experience Across the Web, I Fell in Love with Browsing Moments Again
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article provides an in-depth experience of WeChat's native AI assistant 'XiaoWei', detailing its ubiquitous entry points, core features (message sending, Moments summarization, group chat summarization, Mini Program invocation, AI image generation, etc.), and the product philosophy behind its WeLM model and connected ecosystem.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Is Not the Goal, Knowledge Is the Moat — Knowledge Accumulation Practices of an AI Engineering Delivery Team
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on the engineering delivery practices of an AI Team, this article proposes that knowledge accumulation is more important than workflow orchestration, and systematically introduces a complete methodology encompassing a five-layer knowledge storage architecture, a three-level maturity system, and how workflows serve knowledge accumulation.

relatedArticles.title: DeepSeek Suddenly Releases DSpark, Ending AI's Toothpaste-Squeezing Generation
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: DeepSeek and Peking University jointly released the DSpark inference acceleration framework, which uses a semi-autoregressive draft model and confidence-based scheduling verification to increase online single-user generation speed by 57%-85%.
